# Read the project it is working on

`read.file.project` — **read** × **file** at **project** reach (the working tree or workspace it was pointed at). Family: filesystem. Effect: **undone by the same actor with no loss**.

## Granted by 7 of 9

| Profile | Control on the path | Evidence | Via |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Claude Code — web container](../../../map/grants/anthropic/claude-code-remote/ccr-container/index.md) | ● none | observed | shell (Bash), harness (MCP and built-in tools) |
| [Claude Code — local · confirm off](../../../map/grants/anthropic/claude-code/local-confirmations-off/index.md) | ● none | derived | shell (Bash), files (Read, Edit, Write) |
| [Claude Code — local · confirm on](../../../map/grants/anthropic/claude-code/local-default/index.md) | ● none | derived | shell (Bash), files (Read, Edit, Write) |
| [Claude Desktop — local tools](../../../map/grants/anthropic/claude-desktop/default/index.md) | ● none | derived | conversation, local files and commands (when enabled) |
| [Claude.ai — connectors on](../../../map/grants/anthropic/claude-web/connectors-on/index.md) | ● none | derived | conversation and uploads |
| [GitHub Actions — hosted runner](../../../map/grants/github/actions-runner/ci/index.md) | ● none | observed | the job's shell |
| [ChatGPT — no connectors](../../../map/grants/openai/chatgpt-web/default/index.md) | ● none | derived | conversation and uploads |

## What narrows it

**The setting:** none: this is what it is for

**What it costs:** nothing

**Tier after:** none
